question: Under what name was the Bengal settlement of Serampore known during the period of Danish colonial administration (1755–1845)?
explanation: Serampore was named Frederiksnagore in 1755 in honour of King Frederik V of Denmark, who ruled when the Danish company acquired the land.

question: Serampore College, founded in 1818, received a Royal Charter in 1827 from which Danish King, authorizing it to award degrees in theology and arts?
explanation: King Frederick VI of Denmark issued a Royal Charter in 1827 granting Serampore College university status and the right to confer degrees, making it one of the earliest universities in Asia.
